tips.text: Run Survival, not Defense: you cannot return to space mid-objective, and enemies stranded on the Corpus ship's two floors stall waves for minutes.
Extract at 10 minutes, or stay to 25 or 30 for the next pair of Rotation A rolls.
Bring Khora with Pilfering Strangledome and park in a dead-end room; the loot covers life support solo.
Level a Necramech or other gear during the Survival runs; Void Storms on these nodes add relic rewards.
Farm a second Systems blueprint if you want the Smoking Body Ephemera; it consumes one and each Circuit week gives only one.
Host the Railjack yourself or play solo; co-op on a bad host connection is buggy and public matchmaking is thin.
Bring a basic Railjack with Mk III dojo parts and three hired Ticker crew from Fortuna; that is enough for the space phase.
Wait for Circuit week 3 if it is close; a guaranteed full set beats Railjack drops under 15 percent.
Expect a part to take roughly 5 to 20 tries of 10 to 20 minutes; players call the Railjack route boring rather than hard.
